reviews.t: Great for children with sensory issues
reviews.x: My boys have autism. My younger child has severe sensory issues and doesn't like hair clippers, I was able to get over half his head done before he even noticed with the low buzz of these clippers. My older son even commented how less noisy these were. He was very happy to have a nice hair cut. They are easy to use. I was worried I would mess up but both haircuts turned out great.

reviews.t: A MUST BUY IF YOU HAVE SPECIAL NEEDS CHILDREN
reviews.x: I love these clippers. I bought them for my 19 year old autistic son who has very thick hair and because of the noise and heat and hair pulling other hair clippers make and do. Doing his hair was a nightmare. He would yell,scream. And be in pain. With these clippers. His hair was done in less than 15 minutes. I love the clippers and highly reccomend them. And will purchase again when these wear out.

reviews.t: SO very quiet you can barely hear it!
reviews.x: So first off if you get one thats loud I'd just exchange it. I was hesitant to buy because of some reviews I saw. If you have a child with sensory issues you NEED this! My son doesn't like anything touching his head so he still put up a little fight for most of it but towards the end seemed to not notice it. I love it! It cuts so very well! I just wish it came with longer clips as the longest is only about 1/2". But the clipper size is perfect for little onese!

Thank you for this product.  Did I mention I will save $25 for his haircut!

reviews.t: Perfect for son with autism and SPD.
reviews.x: My son is autistic and has SPD, so my husband cuts his hair to avoid overwhelming him at a salon. He hated my husbands hair clippers so we decided to try these. SO MUCH BETTER! We were worried that we would have to sacrifice quality but it comes with different settings so it’s just as good as my husbands hair clippers that were pretty pricey. If your child struggles with loud noises and haircuts are a struggle, you won’t regret getting these.

reviews.t: Guards pop off WAY too easily
reviews.x: Just received and haven't cut with them yet. The good...quiet, compact, feels solid, and the design seems like it will allow better angle to trim the back of head/neck area of my child (my primary reason to buy this - he is very squirmy).  The bad...plastic teeth? top part is metal, but moving teeth are white plastic.  We'll see how good they cut or last.  The biggest issue right now is the fact that the clipper guards pop off very easily with the slightest pressure upwards on the guard points.

I used this three times. On the third time the guard keep falling off, so bad that I wound up shaving three bald spots on my sons head. The guards will not stay on. Pretty upset. It’s quite which I wanted, it’s sharp and cuts well however the fact that the guards don’t stay on, it’s kinda pointless now, I can’t use it anymore.
I like the size it makes it easy to use it's light really manageable it does make a noise while using it i thought it was going to be quieter

claims.text: Reviewers with autistic or sensory-sensitive children report the clippers are very quiet and much less noisy than regular clippers, making haircuts far easier.
The clippers are lightweight, small, and easy to hold and use.
They cut thick or curly hair effectively and quickly, with haircuts taking much less time than before.
Some reviewers note the product does not come with a wall plug.
Reviewers praise the customer service and overall quality, with some also using the clippers on pets.
